question: Según el pasaje suministrado del procedimiento 2900-003-001, reconstruye en orden las actividades 18 a 22, indicando para cada una responsable, acción principal y documento u objeto. Distingue la remisión de CPIM de las actividades posteriores de CTIM. Responde sólo con lo sustentado por el pasaje.
positive_control: Five steps with the right actors and distinct actions should receive complete / no_omission_found.
negative_control: A candidate with steps 18, 19, 21 and 22, but no step 20 modification-and-agreement activity, should receive omitted / proposed_omissions citing activity 20.
falsification: Any missed step or actor confusion in the generated answer, a false omission for the positive control, or failure to detect step 20 in the negative control prevents a full pass.
scope: One visually checked excerpt from one PDF page; no corpus discovery, document vigency, institutional adjudication or memory admission.
